# Release notes

The newest release is first. In Odoo the version number starts with the Odoo version, so release 1.1.0 for Odoo 20.0 shows as `20.0.1.1.0`.

## 1.2.2

*2026-11-04, Odoo 18.0*

- App description update only: the user guide button on the Odoo Apps Store page now shows the guide address, because the store does not make outside links clickable. No change to how the app works.

## 1.2.1

*2026-11-03, Odoo 18.0*

- Store page and app links now point to this user guide. No change to how the app works.

## 1.2.0

*2026-10-23, Odoo 18.0*

- Now free and open source under AGPL-3.

## 1.1.0

*2026-10-23, Odoo 18.0*

- Payments are verified with Fatora before they are posted.
- Customers return to Odoo correctly after paying.
- Refunds from Odoo.

## 1.0.0

*2026-01-08, Odoo 18.0*

- First release.
